text:
Maya (Sales): @Priya @Alec Opsidian is asking us to complete the SIG Qs for their Private deployment POC. They want question-by-question evidence; procurement wants the bundle before legal kickoff. Can you confirm ownership for Q12 (data residency) and Q45 (encryption-at-rest)? Target: EOD Thu for the zip.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own Q12 (data flows + region mapping) and Q67 (subprocessors). Who has the latest KMS rotation doc?

Alec (Security): I'll take Q45 (encryption) and Q21 (access controls). KMS rotation doc is /security/compliance/kms-rotation-2025.md (internal). I'll pull SOC2 cert and encryption configs.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Draft snippet for 'key management' we can hand to legal: 
```
Keys are managed via AWS KMS. For Private deployments customers may bring their own CMKs; hosted uses Redwood-managed customer-isolated keys. Key rotation and access policies are enforced by KMS and audited.
```
Thoughts?

Alec (Security): Small edit: "customer-controlled CMKs are supported for Private; hosted supports Redwood-managed KMS with per-tenant separation". Also note we rotate service keys every 90 days.

Maya (Sales): Jordan — can you confirm which deployment Opsidian is evaluating? That changes what evidence we need (backup encryption proofs, KMS screenshots, subprocessors list).

Jordan (Opsidian): Jordan (Opsidian): They're evaluating Private. Legal will need proof of customer KMS support, subprocessors list, and confirmation that backups are encrypted at rest.

Priya (Solutions Eng): On Private — I'll pull the Private KMS guide, console screenshots, and a short how-to for customer CMK setup. I'll upload: private-kms-guide.pdf and private-console-kms-screenshots.zip

infra-bot: SOC2-report-2024.pdf uploaded to GCS at gs://redwood-compliance/opsidian/ (access restricted).

Alec (Security): Uploaded encryption-evidence.tar.gz to the same folder (contains q45_policies.md and db-encryption-config.png). Drafting a concise Q45 answer to paste into the SIG.

Priya (Solutions Eng): For Q12 (data residency) we'll reference region-mapping-2025.pdf and retention-policy-2024.md. I'll draft a 2-sentence reply and attach the region map.

Maya (Sales): Can we assemble the final zip and drop in the shared folder by 5pm PT Thu? Opsidian's procurement said legal review starts Fri morning.

Alec (Security): Aiming for that. I've redacted internal-only notes from the SOC bundle. Jordan — if your legal needs an NDA for some artifacts let us know now.

Jordan (Opsidian): No extra NDA needed. Legal just needs the artifacts. Thanks!

Priya (Solutions Eng): Uploaded private-kms-guide.pdf and subprocessors.csv to gs://redwood-compliance/opsidian/. Added short README with file mapping.

Maya (Sales): Confirmed access and just shared the view link with Opsidian legal. :rocket:

Alec (Security): Final checklist: Q12 (region map + retention) ✅, Q21 (access control diagrams + ACLs) ✅, Q45 (encryption config + policy) ✅, Q67 (subprocessors.csv) ✅. Will attach short plain-English answers for each SIG question.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll paste the Q12 and Q67 answers into the SIG template and handoff to Maya for review.

Maya (Sales): Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. If anything changes ping @Maya. :thumbsup:
